description: 对 MiniMax 端点的真实在线调用验证；与历史证据审计相互独立。
patch:
diff --git a/sample/taskmanager.py b/sample/taskmanager.py
--- a/sample/taskmanager.py
+++ b/sample/taskmanager.py
@@ -35,9 +35,12 @@ class TaskStore:
     def list_tasks(self, status: str | None = None) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
         """Return tasks ordered by descending priority then ascending id.
 
         ``status`` optionally filters tasks by exact, case-sensitive status match.
+        The wildcard ``"*"`` treats every task as matching.
         """
 
-        tasks = filter_by_status(self.tasks, None if status == "*" else status)
+        effective_status = None if status == "*" else status
+        tasks = filter_by_status(self.tasks, effective_status)
         return [task.as_dict() for task in sorted(tasks, key=lambda item: (-item.priority, item.id))]
 
     def find_by_id(self, task_id: int) -> Task | None:
task: 根据 SPEC-REQ-001 v1.1.0 (r2) 校验实现：list_tasks 支持按 status 精确筛选，并把通配符 "*" 视为不筛选
